signal: Laurel raised a $100M Series C at a $510M valuation and grew ARR 300%, expanding into accounting and consulting with 100+ top firms deploying its AI time platform

email.body1:
Vivian, saw Laurel close its $100M Series C and grow ARR 300% while expanding into accounting and consulting.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market firms in play than business development can cover before momentum fades, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Laurel off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Vivian, quick follow-up for Laurel.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Laurel needs across legal, accounting, and consulting this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Vivian, last bit of proof for Laurel.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Laurel's reply rate likely compares to other Series-C startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Vivian, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the post-Series-C stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a professional-services motion? I'll tailor it to Laurel either way.
